items.name: Norrkubing 2020
items.information:
#The competition has been cancelled due to the rise of COVID-19 cases in Sweden.#

This is 2020's edition of Norrkubing. A competition which history started in 2015, and this is the 6th time a competition has been organized in this municipality.

The competition is open to everyone but limited to 25 competitors due to regulations regarding covid-19. Visitors are very welcome during the competiton, but every competitor must bring at most one. Registration will happen on this WCA-page and is not considered complete before we have received the payment of the entry fee which has been set to 200 SEK. For more information about this competition, see the tabs.

-----

#Tävlingen har ställts in på grund av ökat antal rapporterade fall av COVID-19 i Sverige.#

Detta är 2020 års upplaga av Norrkubing. Tävlingen arrangerades för första gången år 2015, och detta är den sjätte gången en tävling arrangeras i denna kommun.

Tävlingen är öppen för alla men begränsad till maximalt 25 deltagare på grund av restriktioner kring covid-19. Besökare är varmt välkomna under tävlingen, men varje deltagare får ta med sig maximalt en gäst. Registreringen kommer att ske på denna WCA-sida och anses inte vara färdig innan vi mottagit betalningen av anmälningsavgiften som har fastställts till 200 SEK. För mer information om tävlingen, se flikarna ovan.

items.name: Welcome Back Wellington 2020

venue.name: Victoria University of Wellington, Kelburn Campus
venue.address: Victoria University of Wellington, Kelburn, Wellington 6012

items.information: Welcome Back Wellington 2020 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.name: Cube Weekend Sint Michielsgestel 2020
items.information:
Een compleet weekend met 2 overnachtingen, maaltijden, snacks en natuurlijk een vol wedstrijdprogramma. Lees vóór je aanmelding de uitgebreide informatie op de website van [Speedcubing Nederland](https://www.kubuswedstrijden.nl/kubusweekend2020/). Er is een beperkt aantal bedden voor gasten. Gasten betalen dezelfde prijs als deelnemers. 

A complete weekend with 2 overnight stays, meals, snacks and a complete competition programma. Before you register, please read the detailed information on the website of [Speedcubing Nederland](https://www.kubuswedstrijden.nl/kubusweekend2020/). There is a limited number of beds available for guests. Guests will pay the same price as competitors.

items.name: Ural Autumn 2020
items.information:
На чемпионат нужно принести с собой медицинскую маску , перчатки и ручку . 
Участие на чемпиоате в маске и перчатках , в момент официальных сборок можно будет снимать маску и перчатки. 
Скрамблить и судить строго в маске и перчатках. И всегда делать подпись только своей ручкой .


You need to bring a medical mask, gloves and a pen to the championship.
Participation in the championship wearing a mask and gloves, at the time of official assemblies it will be possible to take off the mask and gloves.
Scrub and judge strictly with a mask and gloves. And always sign with only your own pen.
